title: PHPRegex Lint Configuration
description: Configuration of the regex lint command (regex.json or regex.dist.json). Keys regex.json sets replace the ones regex.dist.json sets: objects key by key, lists whole.

stringList.description: A single string or a list of strings.

digits.description: Optimize digit character classes like [0-9] to \d.

word.description: Optimize word character classes like [A-Za-z0-9_] to \w.

canonicalizeCharClasses.description: Canonicalize character classes (sort ranges, remove duplicates).

possessive.description: Suggest possessive quantifiers (*+, ++, {m,n}+) to prevent ReDoS.

minQuantifierCount.description: Minimum quantifier count required to suggest optimizations (min: 2).

verifyWithAutomata.description: Verify optimization suggestions with the automata solver when possible.

enabled.description: Enable ReDoS vulnerability analysis. Disabled by default for performance; setting mode or threshold does not enable it.

mode.description: ReDoS analysis mode. To turn the analysis off, set enabled to false.
mode.x-expected: theoretical or confirmed (the "off" mode was removed: set checks.redos.enabled to false)

threshold.description: Minimum severity threshold for reporting ReDoS issues.

enabled.description: Enable regex optimization suggestions. Setting minSavings or options does not enable them.

minSavings.description: Minimum character savings threshold to report optimization suggestions.

enabled.description: Enable lint checks for regex anti-patterns and style issues. Setting rules does not enable them.

rules.description: Enable or disable specific lint rules. All rules are enabled by default except unicode.shorthandWithoutU, charclass.single, literal.multipleSpaces, quantifier.lazyToClass and quantifier.uselessLazy.

unicode.shorthandWithoutU.description: Warn when \w, \d, \s are used without /u flag (ASCII-only matching).

unicode.propertyWithoutU.description: Error when \p{...} Unicode properties are used without /u flag.

unicode.bracedHexWithoutU.description: Error when \x{...} escapes with code points > 0xFF are used without /u flag.

unicode.multibyteInClassWithoutU.description: Error when a multibyte character sits in a character class without /u flag (the class matches each byte).

unicode.quantifiedMultibyteWithoutU.description: Error when a quantifier follows a multibyte character without /u flag (only its last byte repeats).

flag.useless.i.description: Warn when /i flag is used but pattern has no case-sensitive characters.

flag.useless.m.description: Warn when /m flag is used but pattern has no anchors.

flag.useless.s.description: Warn when /s flag is used but pattern has no unescaped dot outside a character class.

flag.useless.D.description: Warn when /D flag is used but no $ anchor is read without m.

flag.useless.x.description: Warn when /x flag is used but pattern has no whitespace and no # comment.

flag.override.description: Warn when inline flags override outer flags.

charclass.redundant.description: Warn about redundant character classes like [a].

charclass.suspiciousRange.description: Warn about suspicious character ranges like [A-z].

charclass.suspiciousPipe.description: Warn about literal pipe in character class (likely meant alternation).

charclass.duplicateChars.description: Warn about duplicate elements in character classes.

charclass.backrefAsOctal.description: Warn when \1-\9 in character class is octal, not a backreference.

charclass.literalMetachar.description: Warn about unescaped metacharacters in character classes.

alternation.empty.description: Warn about empty alternatives in alternations.

alternation.duplicateDisjunction.description: Warn about duplicate branches in alternations.

alternation.overlap.description: Warn about overlapping alternatives that may cause backtracking.

alternation.dotNewline.description: Warn about (.|\n) anti-pattern for matching any character.

quantifier.zero.description: Warn about quantifiers that always match zero times.

quantifier.nested.description: Warn about nested quantifiers that may cause catastrophic backtracking.

quantifier.concatenation.description: Warn about concatenated quantifiers that can be optimized.

quantifier.assertion.description: Warn about a quantifier on a lookaround, which lets the match skip it or changes nothing.

quantifier.lazyEnd.description: Warn about a lazy quantifier nothing follows, which always matches its minimum.

group.quantifiedCapture.description: Warn about quantified capturing groups where only last match is retained.

anchor.impossible.start.description: Warn about impossible start anchor positions.

anchor.impossible.end.description: Warn about impossible end anchor positions.

backref.undefined.description: Warn about references to undefined groups.

dotstar.nested.description: Warn about nested dot-star patterns that cause severe backtracking.

overlap.charset.description: Warn about overlapping character sets in alternations.

quantifier.emptyRepeat.description: Warn about an unbounded quantifier on an item that can match the empty string.

anchor.alternationPrecedence.description: Warn when an anchor on the first or last alternative leaves another alternative unanchored, as in ^a|b.

quantifier.possessiveImpossible.description: Warn about a possessive repeat that takes every character the atom after it could read.

anchor.impossible.boundary.description: Warn about a word boundary its two neighbouring characters contradict.

lookaround.impossible.description: Warn about a lookahead the pattern after it contradicts.

group.empty.description: Warn about an empty non-capturing or atomic group.

charclass.single.description: Report a character class holding a single character (style).

literal.multipleSpaces.description: Report a run of literal spaces, clearer as a counted repeat (style).

quantifier.lazyToClass.description: Report a lazy dot before a single closing character, faster as a negated class (perf).

quantifier.uselessLazy.description: Report a lazy quantifier that matches what the greedy one matches (style).

redos.search.description: Report the quadratic cost of an unanchored search whose every attempt is proven linear. It runs under the ReDoS check and is medium: a threshold of medium or low shows it.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor integration.

paths.description: Directories or files to scan for regex patterns. Omit to scan the working directory.

exclude.description: Paths to exclude from scanning. Omit to use the CLI default (vendor).

phpVersion.description: The PHP version the patterns are judged for, as "8.3" or a PHP_VERSION_ID like 80300, or "runtime" for the PHP running the command with the PCRE2 it links. Omit to read it from composer.json (config.platform.php, else the lowest PHP require.php allows), else to use the running PHP. The --php-version option wins over it.
phpVersion.x-expected: a version like "8.3", a PHP_VERSION_ID like 80300, or "runtime"

pcreVersion.description: The PCRE2 release the patterns are judged for, as "10.44". Omit to use the release bundled with the target PHP, or the running PCRE2 when the target is the running PHP. The --pcre-version option wins over it.

extraction.description: Which calls the linter reads patterns from, beyond the native preg_* functions.

interop.description: Wrapper libraries whose static methods carry a regex pattern. Set to [] to look at native preg_* calls only.
interop.x-expected: a list of distinct presets among composer-pcre, nette-utils, spatie-regex, laravel-str

oneOf.description: nette/utils: Nette\Utils\Strings, whose pattern is the second argument.

functions.description: Project helpers carrying a pattern, as "function" or "Some\Class::method". Append "#<index>" when the pattern is not the first argument, and "#<index>:keys" when that argument is an array whose keys hold the patterns.
functions.x-expected: a list of distinct non-empty strings

jobs.description: Number of parallel workers. Omit to auto-detect based on CPU cores.

ide.description: IDE name or custom URL template for clickable file links. Use placeholders like %f, %l, %c, or %relFile%.
ide.x-expected: one of phpstorm, vscode, textmate, sublime, emacs, atom, macvim, an empty string, or a URL template holding %f or %l
